questions.question: A digital attack which tricks people into giving up important information
questions.explanation: Phishing is an attack where people pretend to be someone they're not to trick others into giving them information they shouldn't have access to.

questions.question: A method of guessing a password by trying every possible password until one is correct
questions.explanation: A brute force attack is a method of guessing a password by trying every possible password until one is correct.

questions.question: ____ is a program designed to damage, destroy or steal data or computer systems
questions.explanation: Malware is a piece of software designed to damage, destroy or steal data or computer systems.

questions.question: A type of software that is useless or annoying which takes up space on a computer while providing little function
questions.explanation: Bloatware is a type of software that is useless or annoying which takes up space on a computer while providing little function.

questions.question: Annoying repeated messages or emails, often advertising
questions.explanation: Spam is useless or obnoxious messages sent on the internet repeatedly and to lots of people.

questions.question: A type of malware which infects a computer to steal sensitive information and monitor the user
questions.explanation: Spyware is a type of malware which infects a computer to steal sensitive information and monitor the user, often to track personal information like passwords or location.

questions.question: A ___ is a type of malware that hides itself from normal user level programs by infecting the Kernel, the core of the operating system
questions.explanation: Rootkits attack the Kernel, the core of your computer's operating system, to avoid detection by normal scans.

questions.question: ___ are hackers who work for a business or organization to hack their systems to find weaknesses and help them improve security
questions.explanation: White hats are employed by organizations to help them find security flaws by trying to break in.

questions.question: ___ are hackers who attack businesses or organizations for their own personal gain
questions.explanation: Black hats are malicious actors who exploit security flaws for their own gain.

questions.question: A type of malware disguised as normal software to fool people into installing it
questions.explanation: A Trojan Horse is malware disguised as a safe or normal program to trick people into downloading it.

questions.question: A piece of malware that attatches itself to normal software and infects more of the computer once that program is run is called ___.
questions.explanation: A piece of malware that attatches itself to normal software and infects more of the computer once that program is run is called a virus.

questions.question: ___ is a digital attack that looks to trick people into giving up important information by lying or prentending to be someone they aren't.
questions.explanation: Phishing is an attack where people pretend to be someone they're not to trick others into giving them information they shouldn't have access to

questions.question: ____ takes up space on your computer without doing any real harm besides slowing it down and being annoying.
questions.explanation: Bloatware is a type of software that is useless or annoying which takes up space on a computer while providing little function

questions.question: A ___ is malware which diguises itself as a saf program to trick people into downloading and running it.
questions.explanation: Trojan Horse malware is hidden malware disguised as a safe and normal program to trick people into downloading it.

questions.question: Hackers who try to break into a company or governments system to find security flaws.
questions.explanation: White hat's are employed by organizations to help them find security flaws by trying to break in

questions.question: ____ is a method of guessing a password by entering every possible password until the correct one is found.
questions.explanation: A Brute force is a method of guessing a password by trying every possible password until one is correct

questions.question: ___ are annoying advertisements or messages, often sent via email or through websites.
questions.explanation: Spam is useless or obnoxious messages sent on the internet repeatedly and to lots of people

questions.question: This type of malware hides itself from your computer's antivirus inside the operating system kernel.
questions.explanation: Rootkit's attack the Kernel, the core of your computers operating system to avoid detection by normal scans

questions.question: These hackers attempt to break into other's computers and systems for profit or to cause damage.
questions.explanation: Black hats are malicious (bad/dangerous) actors who are looking to exploit security flaws for their own gain

questions.question: ___ infects your computer to monitor what you do and steal sensitive information.
questions.explanation: Spyware is A type of malware which infects a computer to steal sensitive information and monitor the user, often to track personal information like passwords or location

questions.question: ___ is a piece of software that creates a record of every key pressed on a computer and sends it back to a hacker
questions.explanation: A Keylogger logs keystrokes, usually to send records of everything back to the hacker who deployed it. This can be used to steal personal information or passwords.

questions.question: A ___ is a type of malware that repeatedly copies itself across networks without any human interaction.
questions.explanation: A worm is a piece of malware that spreads and copies itself independently as it infects more machines

questions.question: ___ is malware that locks a person's computer and demands some amount of money in exchange for the password to unlock it or else all their data is lost.
questions.explanation: Ransomware takes over someone's computer and threatens to delete or release all of their files and information if the hacker who deployed the ransomware is not paid within an set amount of time.

questions.question: A coordinated atttack which uses many computers at once to overwhelm and disrupt a network by flooding it with messages/traffic
questions.explanation: A DDoS (Distributed Denial of Service) attack used large networks of computers (called botnets) to flood and overwhelm networks with the goal of preventing real people from accessing the network or anything in it

questions.question: Software designed to infect, damage, steal and destroy data and computer systems
questions.explanation: Malware is a piece of software designed to damage, destroy or steal data or computer systems
